texts.value: Cell adhesion glycoprotein which is widely distributed in basement membranes. Binds to collagens I and IV, to perlecan and to laminin 1. Does not bind fibulins. It probably has a role in cell-extracellular matrix interactions
Interacts with LAMA2 (By similarity). Interacts with COL13A1. Interacts with EFEMP2 (By similarity)

location.value: Secreted, extracellular space, extracellular matrix, basement membrane

texts.value: Detected in placenta (at protein level) (PubMed:32337544). Heart and bone. Less in pancreas, kidney and skeletal muscle
